checks.description: Budgets on the whole output: over a warn the run is recorded as a warning, over an error it publishes nothing

clearedOfWritten.description: Articles with at least one field cleared, as a count or a share of the articles written

error.description: Over this the run fails and publishes nothing: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

warn.description: Over this the run is recorded as a warning: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

droppedOfRead.description: Records dropped, for a missing required field, a malformed row or a drop rule, as a count or a share of the records read

error.description: Over this the run fails and publishes nothing: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

warn.description: Over this the run is recorded as a warning: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

duplicatesOfRead.description: Records dropped as duplicates under unique, as a count or a share of the records read

error.description: Over this the run fails and publishes nothing: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

warn.description: Over this the run is recorded as a warning: a whole count such as 500, or a percentage such as 2%

id.description: How each article gets its id

kind.description: urlHash: the uuidv5 of the url, the same id on every run; random: a new uuidv7 per article on every run

input.description: Raw data package, a datapackage.json or its folder: relative to this file, absolute, https:// or s3://

mapping.description: Mapping spec, relative to this file or absolute

format.description: File format of the articles: parquet (the default) or jsonl; rejects and changes are always parquet

path.description: Folder that receives <version>/, relative to this file or absolute

rules.description: Edits applied in order to the articles kept after unique; each clears a field or drops the article

clear.description: Field to empty on every article the rule matches; it must not be required

drop.description: Remove every article the rule matches

name.description: Name the counts, rejects and changes give this rule

atLeast.description: Matches every article of a group whose distinct count is at least this

countDistinct.description: Field whose distinct values are counted in each group, as in count(distinct ...)

groupBy.description: Fields whose values together form a group, as in group by; an article with any of them empty is in no group

unique.description: Which records are one article: no two kept articles share the values of a key

keep.description: Which record of one article is kept: first is the earliest in the raw package, by resource and then by row

keys.description: Field sets no two kept articles share; values compare with whitespace collapsed, an empty field never matches, and id kind urlHash needs a key on exactly [URL]

fields.description: Article fields whose values together must be unique

name.description: Name the counts and rejects give the records this key drops
